HOW TO PLAY

Every move counts.

Bring your opponent's health to zero before they do the same to you.

  1. 01
    Start with a hand.

    You begin with 40 health, 3 energy, and 5 cards. You can hold up to 5 cards.

  2. 02
    Spend your energy.

    The number on a card is its energy cost. Play as many cards as you can afford, then end your turn.

  3. 03
    Build a strategy.

    Cards can damage, heal, move energy, or apply poison. Some combine several effects. Read the card before playing it.

  4. 04
    Take your next turn.

    Draw 1 card if you have fewer than 5 cards, and gain 3 energy, up to 10. A full hand skips the draw and keeps the card in your deck. Poison deals damage at the start of the poisoned player's turn for its remaining turns.

A random player starts each online match. Online turns have a 30-second limit; time running out automatically ends your turn. A disconnected player has 90 seconds to return. Each player sees only their own hand.
